Purpose

Build a standalone Pi 0.85.1 extension that lets autonomous work compact its context and continue from an exact durable note.

Problem

Long runs consume context and lose working precision. A premature compaction can race tool execution, and a failed handoff can lose the next action or restart completed work.

Solution

Separate usage policy, editable prompts, durable handoff state, and Pi lifecycle integration. Persist notes in session custom entries on the active branch. Start compaction only after all tool work settles. Deliver the original note separately from the generated summary and restore the previously active tools after success.

      [x] Phase 2: Durable standalone extension

      Implement the handoff lifecycle and Pi integration.

      2.1. Handoff

      • [x] Register self_compact with explicit blank and 24,000-character validation. Persist the exact note, handoff ID, cycle, state, and original tool names in branch-local custom entries before returning terminate:true. Detect valid handoffs across sibling calls before execution and block ordinary siblings.

      2.2. Lifecycle

      • [x] Compact only when agent_settled reports idle. Persist requested → compacting → ready → delivered states. On error or cancellation preserve the note and lock. Restore the active tool set only after success, deliver the note verbatim as a custom message, and trigger continuation without human input. Recover pending handoffs on reload and use durable delivery IDs to prevent duplicates.

      2.3. Integration

      • [x] Enforce hard limits in tool preflight and show soft/warning notices once per cycle without restarting completed runs. Override session_before_compact with a modelRegistry.complete request using the configured system prompt, previous summary, serialized history, and abort signal. Cancel on errors instead of falling back silently. Keep built-in compact registered by Pi.

      Notes

      Production defaults are absolute token thresholds. The requested 20% / 50% / 60% bar is an explicit percentage configuration. Small-window models must use lower thresholds. A zero buffer is valid. Hard limits cannot prevent a single unexpectedly large tool result or model response from overshooting.

      Do not mutate global Pi settings. Cancel automatic compaction while a required handoff is pending, letting the idle handoff own the summary. Keep the built-in manual escape hatch available. No human note is fabricated by a retry command. Tests must use the real runtime in addition to mocks.
